To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the nutrient distribution pattern of P.edulis forest with different management modes in Northwest of Fujian is mainly influenced by the nutrient accumulation of tree layer and the soil layer.

the proportion of accumulated nutrients in the soil layer of the Phyllostachyus edulis forest increased while the proportion of accumulated nitrogen and phosphorus decreased, and that the accumulation of nutrients in different forest layers followed the order: soil layer > tree layer > litter layer > shrub layer > herb layer.
the proportion of soil nutrient accumulation accounted for above 99% of the nutrient element accumulation in the P.edulis forest,while that in the tree layer accounted for more than85%.
